info.name: Marketplace — Customer API
info.description:
# Marketplace Customer API

Covers every endpoint under `routes/api_customer.php` — auth, profile, addresses, wishlist, cart & checkout, orders/returns/disputes/reviews/refunds, support tickets, the account area (classified listings, travel bookings, inquiries), and the public catalog/browse/search surface.

## Getting started
1. Set `base_url` (collection variable) to your local/staging API root, e.g. `http://localhost:8000`.
2. Set `country` to a valid, active `site_code` in your database (e.g. `egy`).
3. Run **Auth → Register** (or **Login** if you already have an account). A post-response    *Test* script automatically saves `access_token` / `refresh_token` into collection    variables — every other request inherits `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}`    from the collection-level auth, so you never have to paste tokens by hand.
4. Explore folders top-to-bottom — several "create" requests (Add Cart Item, Create    Address, Place Order, Request Return, Open Dispute, Submit Review, Create Support    Ticket, Create Classified Listing, Create Travel Booking, Send Classified Inquiry)    auto-save the IDs they generate into collection variables so downstream requests    (Update/Get/Cancel/etc.) work with zero manual copy-pasting.

## Why tokens are saved in a `Test` script, not a `Pre-request` script
Pre-request scripts run *before* the request is sent, so they cannot read a response body that doesn't exist yet. Token capture necessarily happens in the **Tests** tab (Postman's post-response script), on Register/Login/Refresh Token. This is the standard, correct place to do it — despite colloquially being called a "pre-request step" in the auth flow sense (i.e., it prepares the token *before your next* request).

## Response envelope
Most endpoints return `App\Http\Responses\ApiResponse`'s envelope: `{"success": true, "message": "...", "data": {...}}` on success, or `{"success": false, "message": "..."}` (+ `errors` if present) on business-rule failures. **Laravel's own validation/model-not-found/auth exceptions bypass this envelope** and return their default shape instead (`{"message": "...", "errors": {...}}` with no `success` key, or plain `{"message": "Unauthenticated."}`). Each request's saved examples call out which shape applies.

## Known issues documented in this collection (not opinions — verified against the code)
- `GET /l/{identifier}` and its legacy alias `GET /products/{identifier}` currently   **always return HTTP 500** (a variable-scope bug in `ListingDetailController::resolveListing`).
- `PUT/DELETE addresses/{address}` and `PUT addresses/{address}/set-default` do **not**   enforce address ownership, despite an unused `AddressPolicy` existing.
- `PUT cart/items/{id}` has dead exception handling — expect an uncaught 404/500 rather   than the clean error shape the (commented-out) code implies.

See each request's description for the full parameter tables, status-code list, and business-logic notes — everything was verified by reading the actual controllers, form requests, and API resources, not inferred from routes alone.

// level, and dynamic values (e.g. Place Order's idempotency_key) use Postman's built-in

variable.description: API root, no trailing slash. Change per environment (local/staging/prod).
Active Country site_code used in every path, e.g. egy, ksa, uae.
JWT access token — auto-populated by Register/Login/Refresh Token Test scripts.
JWT refresh token — auto-populated alongside access_token.
Email verification OTP — copy from the test mailbox/log after Register.
Password reset OTP — copy from the test mailbox/log after Forgot Password.
Address PK (integer) — auto-populated by Create Address.
City UUID — seed/look up from your database.
Country UUID (distinct from the `country` site_code) — seed/look up from your database.
Vendor listing UUID to add to cart/wishlist — look up from List Products.
Cart item UUID — auto-populated by Add Cart Item.
Shipping method UUID — copy from Get Shipping Methods response.
Order number — auto-populated by Place Order.
Order item UUID — copy from Get Order Detail response, needed for Returns/Reviews.
Sub-order number (e.g. NOON-...-01) — copy from Get Order Detail response.
Return number — auto-populated by Request Return.
Dispute number — auto-populated by Open Dispute.
Review UUID — auto-populated by Submit Review.
Refund UUID — copy from List Refunds response.
Support ticket number — auto-populated by Create Support Ticket.
Classified category UUID — seed/look up from your database.
Own classified listing number — auto-populated by Create Classified Listing.
Another seller's classified listing_number to inquire about — look up via Browse/Search.
Travel package UUID/slug used when creating a booking or signing a contract — look up via Travel browse/search.
Travel booking UUID (primary key) — auto-populated by Create Travel Booking.
Travel booking number (e.g. TRV-...) — auto-populated by Create Travel Booking.
Classified inquiry UUID (as buyer) — auto-populated by Send Classified Inquiry.
Product category UUID — look up from Category Tree.
Travel category UUID — look up from Category Tree / Navigation Tree.
Brand UUID — look up from search/product responses.
Vendor UUID — look up from search/product responses.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration, login, token lifecycle, password reset, and email verification. `Register`, `Login`, and `Refresh Token` all auto-save `access_token`/`refresh_token` into collection variables via a post-response Test script — no manual copy/paste needed.

request.description:
Create a new customer account for the resolved `{{country}}`. Always issues a fresh access/refresh token pair on success (auto-login after registration) and dispatches a verification email job.

**Rate limit:** `throttle:10,1` (10 requests/minute per IP).

### Body params
| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | max:255 | Customer display name |
| `email` | string | required | email, max:255, unique | Login email, must be unique |
| `phone` | string | nullable | max:20, unique | Optional phone, must be unique if provided |
| `password` | string | required | min:8, confirmed | Plaintext password (hashed server-side) |
| `password_confirmation` | string | required (via `confirmed` rule) | must match `password` | Confirmation field |
| `referral_code` | string | nullable | size:8 | Another customer's referral code to credit |


---
**Path prefix note:** `{{country}}` is a collection variable resolving to the site `site_code` (e.g. `egy`, `ksa`, `uae`). If the code doesn't match an active country, every route in this API (public or authenticated) returns:
```json
{"success": false, "message": "Country not found or not active."}
```
with status **404**, before auth or validation runs.

exec: console.log('Saved access_token / refresh_token to collection variables.');
pm.test('Request failed — see response body for details', () => {});

Returns (creating if necessary) the customer's cart for `{{country}}`. **Side effect:** every call recalculates the cart — drops items whose listing became inactive/deleted, re-syncs prices to the live listing price, and bumps `expires_at` by 30 days. `estimated_shipping_cents` is always `0` here; real shipping only appears from Checkout → Shipping Methods onward.

**Auth:** Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` (JWT, `customer` guard). Missing/invalid/expired token returns **401**:
```json
{"message": "Unauthenticated."}
```
(Laravel's default shape — no `success` key, since this is thrown by the auth middleware, not the app's `ApiResponse` helper.)

---
**Path prefix note:** `{{country}}` is a collection variable resolving to the site `site_code` (e.g. `egy`, `ksa`, `uae`). If the code doesn't match an active country, every route in this API (public or authenticated) returns:
```json
{"success": false, "message": "Country not found or not active."}
```
with status **404**, before auth or validation runs.

request.description:
Creates the order from the current cart. **Rate limit:** `throttle:5,1`.

### Body params
| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `address_id` | integer | required | integer, exists:addresses,id | Shipping address |
| `shipping_method_id` | string(uuid) | required | uuid, exists:shipping_methods,id | Chosen method |
| `payment_method` | string | required | in: card, wallet, cod, bnpl, bank_transfer | Payment method |
| `coupon_code` | string | nullable | max:50 | Optional coupon |
| `customer_notes` | string | nullable | max:500 | e.g. "Leave at door" |
| `idempotency_key` | string | required | max:100 | Client-generated key; replaying a key tied to a **pending or succeeded** transaction returns 409 with the prior order_number. Use `{{$guid}}` in Postman to generate a fresh one per send. |
| `gateway_token` | string | required_if payment_method=card | — | Tokenized card reference from gateway SDK |
| `gateway` | string | required_if payment_method=card | in: thawani, stripe, tap | Payment gateway |

**Note:** a `201` response does not guarantee `payment_status:"succeeded"` — for `card` payments, gateway failure is reflected as `payment_status:"failed"` / `status:"cancelled"` inside a still-`201` body, since payment happens after the DB transaction commits. For `cod`, `payment_status` correctly stays `"pending"` here too — cash hasn't changed hands yet. It only flips to `"captured"` once the delivery agent collects payment on delivery (see `Delivery\AssignmentController::confirmDelivery`), which also flips the underlying `PaymentTransaction` from `pending` to `succeeded` in lockstep.

**Auth:** Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` (JWT, `customer` guard). Missing/invalid/expired token returns **401**:
```json
{"message": "Unauthenticated."}
```
(Laravel's default shape — no `success` key, since this is thrown by the auth middleware, not the app's `ApiResponse` helper.)

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `payment_method` | string | required | in: card, wallet, cod, bnpl, bank_transfer | Payment method |
| `coupon_code` | string | nullable | max:50 | Optional coupon |
| `customer_notes` | string | nullable | max:500 | e.g. "Leave at door" |
| `idempotency_key` | string | required | max:100 | Client-generated key; replaying a key tied to a **pending or succeeded** transaction returns 409 with the prior order_number. Use `{{$guid}}` in Postman to generate a fresh one per send. |

variable.description: Order the returned items belong to

request.description:
Submits a return request for one or more items on the order.

### Body params
| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `order_item_ids` | array | required | min:1 | Order item UUIDs to return |
| `order_item_ids.*` | string(uuid) | required | uuid, exists:order_items,id | ⚠️ existence check is global, not scoped to this order |
| `reason` | string | required | in: changed_mind, wrong_item, defective, damaged, not_as_described, size_issue, quality_issue, arrived_late, other | Return reason |
| `return_type` | string | required | in: refund, exchange, store_credit | Desired resolution |
| `comments` | string | nullable | max:2000 | Extra details |

> ⚠️ No backend enforcement of the 14-day return window or delivered-status — those are informational-only flags on Get Order Detail (`can_return`). Also: if `order_item_ids` belong to a different order than `:order_number`, the service can hit a null-pointer fatal error (empty collection) — pass items that truly belong to this order.

**Auth:** Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` (JWT, `customer` guard). Missing/invalid/expired token returns **401**:

request.description:
Opens a new support ticket (multipart — supports one optional attachment). The first message body doubles as the ticket's `description`.

### Body params (multipart/form-data)
| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `category` | string | required | in: order_issue, payment_issue, account, technical, product_inquiry, policy, payout, catalog, other | Ticket category |
| `subject` | string | required | max:255 | Short summary |
| `message` | string | required | max:10000 | Full description / first message |
| `priority` | string | nullable | in: low, normal, high, urgent | Defaults to `normal` |
| `order_number` | string | nullable | max:30 | Related order (must belong to this customer, else silently ignored — no error) |
| `attachment` | file | nullable | max:10240 KB, mimes: jpg,jpeg,png,pdf,doc,docx | Optional single file |


**Auth:** Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` (JWT, `customer` guard). Missing/invalid/expired token returns **401**:

```
(Laravel's default shape — no `success` key, since this is thrown by the auth middleware, not the app's `ApiResponse` helper.)

request.description:
Creates a classified listing as a seller (multipart). If the resolved category has a `contract_template_id`, the listing starts as `pending_contract`; otherwise `pending_review`. Category-specific requirements (`requires_location_map`, `requires_sketch_upload`, `required_attachment_types`) are enforced with a 422 on create (but only loosely re-checked, not enforced, on update).

### Body params (multipart/form-data)
| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `classified_category_id` | string(uuid) | required | exists:classified_categories,id | Category |
| `country_id` | string(uuid) | required | exists:countries,id | Listing country |
| `city_id` | string(uuid) | nullable | exists:cities,id | Listing city |
| `listing_purpose` | string | required | in: sale, rent | Sale or rental listing |
| `title_en` | string | required | max:255 | English title |
| `title_ar` | string | required | max:255 | Arabic title |
| `description_en` | string | nullable | — | English description |
| `description_ar` | string | nullable | — | Arabic description |
| `price_cents` | integer | required | min:0 | Price in minor units (cents) |
| `currency` | string | required | size:3 | ISO 4217 code, e.g. EGP |
| `price_negotiable` | boolean | optional | boolean | Defaults to false |
| `attributes[key]` | any | nullable | category-specific | Free-form attributes, e.g. `attributes[mileage_km]=45000` |
| `latitude` | number | nullable | between:-90,90 | Required if category.requires_location_map |
| `longitude` | number | nullable | between:-180,180 | Required if category.requires_location_map |
| `images[]` | file[] | required | min:1, image, max:10240 KB each | First image (index 0) becomes primary |
| `sketch_file` | file | nullable | max:20480 KB | Required if category.requires_sketch_upload |
| `attachments[type]` | file | nullable | max:20480 KB each | Keyed by attachment type, e.g. `attachments[national_id]` |

Body fields are the same as Create Classified Listing but all optional/`sometimes`.

{"message": "Unauthenticated."}
```
(Laravel's default shape — no `success` key, since this is thrown by the auth middleware, not the app's `ApiResponse` helper.)

**Path prefix note:** `{{country}}` is a collection variable resolving to the site `site_code` (e.g. `egy`, `ksa`, `uae`). If the code doesn't match an active country, every route in this API (public or authenticated) returns:
```json
{"success": false, "message": "Country not found or not active."}
```
with status **404**, before auth or validation runs.
